slides.headline: 26 rare turtles found taped up in luggage
slides.subline: **Critically endangered.** Customs found them at Amsterdam's airport.
slides.credit: Agencia Informativa Conacyt / UdeG / CC BY 4.0 (Vallarta mud turtle, file photo)

slides.body: Dutch customs at **Amsterdam's Schiphol airport** found [[26 Vallarta mud turtles]] in the checked baggage of a man flying from Mexico to Hong Kong.
Most were in a box with **a toy car**. Others were in [[a closed sock]] inside a suitcase. All were wrapped in duct tape so they could not move.
Thought to be the **smallest freshwater turtles** on Earth, about [[10 cm (4 in)]] long. Fewer than **300** may exist in the wild, so the 26 may be [[nearly 10%]].

**All 26 survived.** The tape was removed at a specialist sanctuary. The man remains in custody while [[the investigation]] continues. Should smuggling wildlife carry tougher penalties? Tell us below.
